comment: Variation of docorner-cursor-after-last-glyph-repeat-name with the default symbol set and another role: ^A repeats #name, and the group accelerator 'n' picks 'the type of an object in inventory', so getobj("call") waits unprompted with the cursor where wintty.c docorner() left it. A letter that is not in the inventory then gets "You don't have that object."
